notes.title: V1.0.3 - Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Fixed 2 issues: 

[list]
[*] Player walk animation was still playing when input was disabled.
[*] Enemy right punch was not doing damage. 
[/list]

notes.title: V1.0.2 - Easy Mode Added
notes.content: Added a simple easy mode which can be found in the pause menu. For now, it simply gives you 10 hearts instead of 5. You will need to restart the day when switching difficulties.
